protocol.bootstrap_unit: source image pair, shared across corruptions and fixed seeds; seeds are not a population sample
protocol.deployed_selection: deterministic argmax, same as candidate selection used in generator updates
protocol.evaluation_corruption_mixture: each of four conditions 1/4; generator proxy is not an unbiased gradient of this qualification distribution
protocol.gate_target: actual PNG/UTF8 exp(-gamma * utility), squared moment prediction error; argmax raw score minimizes the predicted moment
protocol.generator_attribution_gate: joint_risk exceeds an offline target-aware original-generator oracle over all 16 two-action sequences; paired test CE lower bound > 0 and each fixed seed positive
protocol.generator_objective: supervised reconstruction/caption/semantic proxy on selected deployed plan, 0.1 all-plan anchor, 0.3 same-plan teacher distillation on clean replay
protocol.matched_training_gate: joint_risk-joint_uniform test CE lower bound > 0, every fixed seed positive, retention lower bound >= -0.01
protocol.new_test_sources: official MNIST test pixels outside every source hash in the restored full002 corpus and historical prior-heldout exclusion
protocol.oracle_scope: offline privileged upper bound for the original generator at the same two-transition depth, same latent noise and final decoder; extra oracle search/target access is not an equal-budget deployed arm
protocol.primary_generator_gate: joint_risk-frozen test CE lower bound > 0, every fixed seed positive, retention lower bound >= -0.01
protocol.risk_weight: exp(-gamma * actual selected-plan utility), normalized across the whole minibatch and detached
protocol.same_training_budget: identical batches, latent noise, 4 plans, forced/free decoders, PNG roundtrips, fixed observer calls and optimizer updates
protocol.scope: constructed MNIST pair generation; no writer metadata, natural AV synthesis, production owner or global unrestricted optimality claim
protocol.selection: maximize actual reward-observer CE on all 4 conditions subject to clean validation CE >= original-0.005; original is eligible; tie favors smaller update then earlier checkpoint
protocol.training_corruption_mixture: clean 1/2, each stress condition 1/6; extra clean replay is a capability-preservation regularizer
